verdict.rationale: Sentry's docs confirm a general-purpose web API for managing organizations, teams, and data export (sentry-docs-14, sentry-docs-20), plus an MCP server for AI agents to search issues, analyze performance, and manage projects (sentry-docs-2). However, there is no explicit claim of full UI/API parity, and a probe for a discoverable OpenAPI spec returned 404s across all candidate paths (sentry-probe-2), suggesting the API surface may not be fully self-documenting or complete for AI-native tooling. Missing for 10: explicit vendor statement of full API/UI parity, a working OpenAPI/swagger spec, and independent verification that all UI actions (e.g., dashboard configuration, alert rule creation) are API-accessible.
